title: Forming his own big band
summary: Roy had a big band in 1943 and no longer booked with Glaser.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So when you split from there, you started your own band again?
Let me see, did I start my own band again? I had a band in '43, didn't I. So it must have been there. That's when I started that band, yeah. The (?)Fish Market(?)
band. Right, I had a big band there. I played around with that.
That was really big. I mean, that was bigger than what you had in the Arcadia band.
Oh yeah, that was a big band. I had three or four trombones, four trumpet, full reed section, guitar. Yeah.
Was Glaser still booking you then?
